usage: arb-engine backtest [-h] [--espn ESPN] [--rh-home RH_HOME] [--rh-away RH_AWAY]
                           [--pm-home PM_HOME] [--pm-away PM_AWAY] [--kalshi-home KALSHI_HOME]
                           [--kalshi-away KALSHI_AWAY] [--week WEEK] [--season SEASON]
                           [--sport {nfl,ncaaf}] [--limit LIMIT] [--no-polymarket]
                           [--contracts CONTRACTS] [--json JSON]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --espn ESPN           ESPN event id (from `arb-engine games` keys / ESPN URLs)
  --rh-home RH_HOME     Robinhood contract id for the home team (from the catalogue / fixtures)
  --rh-away RH_AWAY
  --pm-home PM_HOME     Polymarket token id for the home outcome
  --pm-away PM_AWAY
  --kalshi-home KALSHI_HOME
                        override Kalshi ticker (default derived from teams + ET date)
  --kalshi-away KALSHI_AWAY
  --week WEEK           replay every finished game of this NFL regular-season week (Kalshi +
                        Polymarket + ESPN + model) and fit the blend weights
  --season SEASON
  --sport {nfl,ncaaf}
  --limit LIMIT         with --week: only the first N games
  --no-polymarket       with --week: skip the Polymarket history lookup
  --contracts CONTRACTS
                        with --week: contracts per simulated STEAL/LOCK entry
  --json JSON           write the full replay to this file
